drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy without CC/MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Transthoracic echo: LVEF 60%, grade I diastolic dysfunction

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 75-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.47, bnp 241, creatinine 0.85, hemoglobin 13, platelets 262, sodium 138, wbc 7.7; vitals dbp 76-81, heart_rate 80-85, map 93-97, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-16, sbp 128-133, spo2 96-98, temp 36.9-37.1
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Furosemide 20 mg PO daily (home med); Transthoracic echo: LVEF 60%, grade I diastolic dysfunction
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. CHF.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.81, hemoglobin 12.9, platelets 266, sodium 139, wbc 8.1; vitals dbp 77-82, heart_rate 81-84, map 94-98, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-17, sbp 127-131, spo2 96-98, temp 36.9-37.2
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Furosemide 20 mg PO daily (home med)
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. CHF. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 75-year-old female, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. CHF. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed.
